answer: Like a resilient mycelium network where severed threads wither in isolation, consensus anchors trust in cryptographic entanglement. A rogue node cannot simply wander across the network or isolate itself like a solitary island; forging valid peer interactions requires transitive staking. Any identity conjured out of thin air dissolves like a loose dune before collective verification. Because cross-attestation demands mutually locked collateral, an adversary attempting mass duplication faces exponential attacker cost to sustain artificial influence across the mesh.
